rows.commentary: 5.3: Arshdeep Singh fires in a scorching 131ks yorker that Daryl Mitchell can only jam awkwardly into the off-side dirt.
5.4: Arshdeep nails another pinpoint wide yorker, leaving Mitchell completely beaten before the umpire waves away his frantic wide appeal.
5.5: Advancing past his crease to disrupt the wide yorker tactic, Mitchell finally connects, lifting it over mid-off for a boundary as it loses pace before the fence.
5.6: Arshdeep cleverly adapts by slipping a full delivery into the pads, clipping Mitchell's thigh pad and racing past Sanju's desperate full-length dive for leg byes.
6.1: Axar Patel offers a flat delivery that Finn Allen immediately steers off the back foot to collect a single.
6.2: Daryl Mitchell works a length ball cleanly through mid-wicket, though Axar's sharp fielding cuts off the second run.
6.3: Clearing his front foot with predatory intent, Finn Allen muscles a flat pull deep over mid-wicket for a maximum.
6.4: Allen rocks back on the crease and punches a sharp back-foot defensive stroke straight to cover.
6.5: Allen leaves a wide delivery assuming it will drift past the tramlines, but it stays just inside the legal line.
6.6: Reaching out to a wide offering, Allen unleashes a thunderous flat stroke over cover that sails all the way for six.
7.1: Shuffling across smartly, Daryl Mitchell executes a breathtaking scoop off a length delivery to deposit it cleanly over fine leg for six.
7.2: Mitchell rises on his toes to smoothly turn a shortish delivery behind square for a single.
7.3: Prince Yadav serves a low full toss that Finn Allen sweeps away toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
7.4: Prince Yadav drops it short to Daryl Mitchell, who rocks back and pulls it emphatically over backward square leg for six.
7.5: Prince Yadav unleashes a pinpoint yorker that Daryl Mitchell manages to dig out toward wide mid-on for one.
7.6: Prince Yadav targets the stumps with a yorker, allowing Finn Allen to nudge it past the bowler for a single.
6.5: Michael Bracewell floats it up full, and Abhishek Sharma drills the delivery cleanly through point to pick up a single.
6.6: Michael Bracewell fires in a yorker on the stumps, forcing Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to toe-end his drive down to long-on for one.
7.1: Matthew Fisher traps Vaibhav Sooryavanshi for 45 as the cramped batter lofts it toward long-on where Daryl Mitchell completes a brilliant running, diving catch.
7.2: Matthew Fisher oversteps on a short of length delivery outside off, conceding a no-ball as Sanju Samson guides it down to third man for a single.
7.2: Matthew Fisher gifts a free-hit with a short slower ball that sits up, and Abhishek Sharma rocks back to launch it emphatically over mid-wicket for six.
7.3: Matthew Fisher loses his radar and fires this delivery wide of the off-stump to signal a wide.
7.3: Matthew Fisher bangs it in and Abhishek Sharma sends it towering high into orbit, clearing the ropes despite a desperate tumbling effort from the fielder near the advertising cushions.
7.4: Matthew Fisher induces a miscued skier from Abhishek Sharma off a full delivery, and Mitchell Santner backpedals from mid-off only to spill the swirling chance.
7.5: Matthew Fisher delivers a very full ball around off, allowing Abhishek Sharma to squeeze it toward mid-off and scamper across for a single.
7.6: Matthew Fisher extends the over further by straying down the leg-side and firing a wide to Sanju Samson.
7.6: Matthew Fisher serves up a full slot delivery, enabling Sanju Samson to back away and majestically loft over mid-off while holding his pose.
8.1: Mitchell Santner darts a 95ks delivery straight into the blockhole, beating Abhishek Sharma as the ball squirms under the toe-end of the bat.
8.2: Mitchell Santner darts it through at ninety-four clicks, shaping across the left-hander as Abhishek Sharma chops it towards cover for a brisk single.
8.3: Santner slides one in with the arm at ninety, allowing Sanju Samson to clear his front leg and chip it cleanly over the cover infield.
